name: AI Upscaler Plugin
overview: AI-Powered Video Upscaling Plugin with Docker Microservice Architecture
description: Video upscaling through an external AI service, with client-side scaling and optional object masking. Backend and model availability depend on the installed image and hardware. HDR processing is limited to single PQ/BT.2020 RGB16 frames; target-hardware validation is required.
changelog: v1.8.3.31: Remove the image-action rate limit from playback frames/chunks; forward busy/error responses and Retry-After; serialize player captures with abortable requests and backoff; guard driver upscaling and object masking; enforce measured Auto-mode performance; reject invalid model categories and unsupported HDR; fail library jobs on AI errors without local resize/original-frame substitution; enforce nonempty passing TRX and publish-only runtime packaging. Target-server acceptance was explicitly waived by the owner; GPU, live-player and HDR target-hardware behavior remain unverified.
